abilities.name: Effort
abilities.description: Instead make the creature unconscious until you use a recovery (requires two levels of Effort).

abilities.name: Prepared Medic
abilities.description: With access to a medical field kit (or similar equipment), you can use treatment in half the normal amount of time or treat twice as many wounds for one character in the normal time. Enabler.

system.description:
A Space Opera Type focused on medic archetypal play, with clear room for a character's own story and abilities.

Genre: Science Fiction. Subgenre: Space Opera. Primary Pools: intellect.
